findings.defect: The C952 negative plan used a SOURCE= form whose program also violates the separate p4 dynamic-type restriction, so it is invalid for two independent reasons and cannot isolate C952.
findings.correction: The plan now uses MOLD=, whose source-expr declared type is still governed by C952 while p4's SOURCE= dynamic-type restriction does not apply, with a CLASS(*) allocatable coarray allocate-object so type compatibility is otherwise satisfied, and it states the attribution explicitly.
findings.reviewer_closeout: Confirmed that C952 applies to a MOLD= source-expr and that p4 and C954 do not, so the isolation is genuine.

findings.defect: The S9.7.1.1-004 forbidden-dynamic-type plan did not declare the multi-image coarray execution gating it requires, although other coarray facets in the same packet were gated correctly.
findings.correction: The plan now states that gated multi-image coarray execution is required because the allocate-object is a coarray and 9.7.1.2 p4-p5 impose same-statement participation and synchronization across active images.
findings.reviewer_closeout: Confirmed the gating statement is accurate and that no other plan in the packet has the same omission.

explicit_limitations: Source registration only: no test program, compiler invocation, oracle, canonical link, SourceUse relationship or fixture approval is created.
All 119 facets remain pending. Many coarray facets are explicitly gated on the separately provisioned multi-image capability, which this batch does not exercise.

Runtime conditions such as allocation status at execution, image participation and STAT values carry no invented static diagnostic duty, and no plan relies on deliberate allocation failure, unallocated reads, address arithmetic, TRANSFER or emitted assembly as an oracle.
